about.zh: 深蓝色 Q 版小鲸鱼，圆脑袋、大眼睛、张着嘴；等待时正面朝向观众，游动时侧身。
about.en: A chubby deep-blue chibi whale with a round head, big eyes and an open mouth; faces the viewer when idle and turns side-on when swimming.
